full_page.content:
1946, March 23
Nr. and Mrs. Joseph J. O'Donnell. Page 2
P.S. Dear Joseph: I shall inform Father Provincial of your proposition and will probably hear from him before long. He naturally must feel a relief whenever he finds anyone able and willing to help in such a financial difficulty. Fr. Sol.
1946, June 18
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.N. Cap.
Peace of the Lord June 18th, 1946
God bless you, lir. and Mrs. Joseph and Mrs. O'Donnell.
liany thanks for your recent favors - duly received and noted. 'e are preparing for the glorious Feast of Corpus Christi this Thursday and next Sunday - with procession and Benediction at the Monastery - garden Shrine, at 2:30 the latter date. It would be an edifying treat - the only time in the year that the Garden is open to Cath. public. . . . Furthermore, since our Father Provincial was called to Rome to be lost nev. General; we are to have a provincial Chapter, July 11 - 14th. Please help us stor Heaven for guidance. . . Praised be Jesus!
Sincerely in Christ
Fr. Solanus, O. F.M. Cap.

Many thanks for your recent favors - duly received and noted.
We are preparing for the glorious Feast of Corpus Christi this Thursday and next Sunday - with procession and Benediction at the Monastery - garden Shrine, at 2:30 the latter date. It would be an edifying treat - the only time in the year that the Garden is open to Cath. public.
. . . Furthermore, since our Father Provincial was called to Rome to be Most Rev. General; we are to have a provincial Chapter, July 11 - 14th. Please help us storm Heaven for guidance. . . Praised be Jesus!
